slides.text: I signed up for a beginner’s spin class at my local gym. The room was dark, smelled intensely of iron, and people were wearing leather harnesses. I just assumed it was some trendy new CrossFit thing. The instructor, a giant man covered in tribal tattoos, locked the door. 'Today,' he roared, holding up a medieval broadsword, 'only one of you will leave this room alive!'

I was wearing bright pink Lululemon leggings and holding a water bottle. Everyone else was drawing daggers. 'Excuse me,' I raised my hand politely. 'Is this not Tuesday morning Cardio Blast with spin instructor Gary?' The giant man pointed his sword at my chest. 'This is the Blood Crucible of the Shadow Assassins!' I blinked. 'So... no cycling then? Because I prepaid for six sessions.'

The assassins completely paused. The giant lowered his sword, looking incredibly awkward. 'You prepaid?' he whispered. I nodded, showing him the app on my phone. 'Well, we can't do refunds. Corporate is a nightmare,' he sighed, rubbing his temples. He handed me a throwing star. 'Just stand in the back. Do some squats. And if Steve from accounting attacks you, aim for the jugular.'
